description:
Build strength. Keep it simple.

Lean Muscle Club helps you build a fitness routine around manageable workouts and everyday habits. The app interface is currently in Simplified Chinese.

MOVE WITH A PLAN
Choose from four ready-to-use routines: home basics, a home progression, gym basics, and mobility. Follow exercise cues, mark each set, and use rest timers to keep your session moving.

SEE THE MOVEMENT
Watch animated exercise demonstrations. Pause a demo, slow it down, or view a representative pose. Demonstration speed does not set your workout pace.

KEEP DAILY HABITS VISIBLE
Log your water intake and sleep duration. Review today's check-ins alongside your training activity.

FOLLOW YOUR OWN PROGRESS
Review recent activity and record changes in weight and waist measurements. Focus on your own consistency rather than comparing bodies.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH
With your permission, view sleep, weight, and waist measurements from Apple Health alongside your manual records. Health data is read-only and is not uploaded by the app.

LOCAL-FIRST TRACKING
Core tracking works without an account. Training and body records are stored locally, not uploaded by the app. You can export your records when you choose. System backups may include app data.

Exercise content provides general fitness information, not medical advice or an individualized training prescription. Choose movements and intensity that suit your circumstances. Stop if you experience pain or feel unwell.
promotionalText: Build a routine that fits your day. Follow guided workouts, track water and sleep, and review your progress in one simple, local-first app.
